description: This file is a Python script for a linter adapter related to the 'gb_registry' in the PyTorch project. It handles registry synchronization, duplicate detection, and code analysis for the graph break registry, including functions for collecting calls, creating registry entries, and updating the registry based on source code analysis.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enum class defining severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple class representing a lint message with details such as path, severity, description, etc.

methods.name: _collect_all_calls
methods.description: Collects all calls from source files in a directory, mapping gb_type to call info and file path.

methods.name: _create_registry_entry
methods.description: Creates a standardized registry entry dictionary for a given gb_type, context, explanation, and hints.

methods.name: _update_registry_with_changes
methods.description: Calculates and returns an updated registry based on new calls and renames.

methods.name: check_registry_sync
methods.description: Main function to check synchronization between source code and registry, returning lint messages.
